title: CXCL13 as a Prognostic Biomarker of Survival Outcomes in Muscle-Invasive Bladder Cancer

contributions.purpose: 评估 CXCL13 表达对 MIBC 的预后价值
contributions.mechanism: TCGA-BLCA 404 例按 CXCL13 75分位分高低组做 KM/log-rank
contributions.evaluation: 高表达组 OS log-rank p=0.0059,PFS p=0.035
contributions.domain: 膀胱癌预后生物标志物
contributions.source_quote: high CXCL13 expression was significantly associated with improved overall survival (OS; p = 0.0059) and progression-free survival (PFS; p = 0.035).

contributions.purpose: 证明独立于临床协变量的预后价值
contributions.mechanism: 多变量 Cox 校正年龄、性别、分期
contributions.source_quote: For OS, the hazard ratio was 0.60 (95% CI 0.42-0.85, p = 0.005) with a concordance index of 0.66. For PFS, the hazard ratio was 0.58 (95% CI 0.40-0.82, p = 0.002)

contributions.purpose: 揭示预后效应的分期异质性
contributions.mechanism: 分期分层 KM 分析(II/III/IV)
contributions.evaluation: 仅 Stage III 显著(OS p=0.015 HR=0.45,PFS p=0.035 HR=0.48);Stage II/IV 无显著差异
contributions.source_quote: In Stage III patients, high expression was associated with markedly better outcomes... In contrast, Stage II and Stage IV patients showed no significant survival differences

self_declared_provenance.quote: These findings extend prior mechanistic insights into TLS biology by providing quantitative, stage-specific evidence of CXCL13's prognostic relevance.
No study to date has comprehensively evaluated CXCL13 expression alone as a prognostic biomarker for both PFS and OS across publicly available data. Our work addresses this gap

notes: 数据红旗:阈值挑选=p-hacking——自述评估了 median/60/70/75 四个分位点,选 75 分位"因为它对 OS 与 PFS 都产生统计显著的 KM 曲线分离"(threshold hacking),显著性由此存疑。Stage II/IV 为负结果(无显著关联),作者归因于亚组功效不足。局限自述充分:单一回顾性队列 TCGA-BLCA、bulk RNA-seq 不含空间 TLS 上下文、缺外部验证。checklist AI 披露:假设[D]AI主导、实验设计[D]>95%AI、写作[C];自曝 AI 常产生冗余/离题文本、数据可得性限制假设验证。code"available upon request"未真开源。
